exactly_twenty_type_7.hand_calculation: The twenty overlapping windows are 1..20 L/min; Q50=(10+11)/2=10.5; Q95=19+0.05*(20-19)=19.05; ratio=19.05/10.5

nineteen_windows.hand_calculation: Only the 78000 ms run admits windows: floor((78000-60000)/1000)+1=19; the four other runs are each shorter than 60000 ms

one_ms_below.hand_calculation: 300000 requested ms - 1 excluded ms = 299999 eligible ms

positive_flow_only.hand_calculation: Every 60000 ms window has 750 positive 40 ms cells and 750 clamped negative cells: 10*750*40/60000=5 L/min; Q50=Q95=5

partial_sample_cell.hand_calculation: The long eligible run [39,300040) starts inside the first 40 ms Flow Rate cell; every complete window still integrates constant 10 L/min exactly

overlapping_leak_and_artifact.hand_calculation: union([40,160), [100,200)) removes 160 ms, leaving 300000 eligible ms without admitting a window across the exclusion

split_sessions.hand_calculation: Each session supplies 91 windows; Q50 lies halfway between the 91st value 5 and 92nd value 15, while Q95=15; ratio=15/10

nonpositive_median.hand_calculation: All negative Flow Rate cells clamp to zero, so Q50=Q95=0 and the ratio is not calculated
